Use case: style-transfer. Redraw a single game chibi head-and-shoulders avatar for a coordinated six-character icon set. The reference identifies this character, NOT its old rendering/detail level. TRANSPARENT background, one isolated character, square 1024x1024 image, no border, no words, no props in hands. Standardized framing: face centered horizontally, eyes near 53% canvas height, chin near 81%, visible face oval about 49% canvas width; head including hair about 84% canvas width, hair/hat top 5% and small shoulder base cropped at 96%. Keep the face equally large across this set, compress oversized hats or ponytails rather than making the face smaller. Three-quarter view close to frontal, minimal head tilt, charming distinctly chibi proportions with large readable eyes and a compact small body. Designed to be clear at 48x48: bold coherent silhouette, strong separated light/midtone/shadow groups, crisp eye shapes, clear mouth, only major identity accessories, simplified larger shapes rather than tiny details.
Project default painting: hand-painted Japanese anime with opaque layered color blocks and firm light-shadow boundaries. Coherent clean flowing ribbon-like hair locks, continuous base and midtone with long grouped shadows and a few broad luminous bands following curvature. Selective weight-varying drawn contours around eyelids and major overlaps. Calm warm matte skin, clear fringe/neck shadows, layered luminous irises and just one or two highlights. Quiet large chromatic-gray fields with concentrated vivid accents, dark cloth retains readable colored-gray planes. Economical principal folds. No dense hair strands, tiny mosaic facets, scratchy white streaks, noisy speckles, glossy plastic rendering or diffuse washed-out face edges. Preserve actual alpha transparency.

Character WU: silver-white high ponytail, blue bow at its root, black rose on viewer RIGHT at temple, ordinary thin round black sunglasses resting on top of head (not goggles). Clearly parted swept-aside front hair exposes a broad forehead, eyebrows and both cyan-blue eyes. Confident playful smile with a tiny fang. Black/charcoal off-shoulder ruffle neckline, single dark diagonal sword strap. Simplify ruffles into two or three strong shapes. Image 1 is the old avatar identity reference; image 2 is the CURRENT authoritative full portrait for forehead, sunglasses and costume. Do not copy its full-body composition.
